observation.visible_scene: A dance studio with a full-width mirror wall, framed pictures mounted above it, and a string of small lights running along its base. A woman with dark hair in a bun, wearing a long-sleeved patterned top and black trousers, stands barefoot with her back to the camera, facing the mirror; her reflection is the only 'second figure' visible. Her right arm hangs at her side and her feet stay planted throughout.
visible_changes: The raised left arm slowly lowers and rotates: it begins extended diagonally upward with the hand pointing high, then progressively drops to roughly shoulder/head height by the last frame, ending with the elbow bent and the open palm facing toward the mirror.
The head, which initially tilts upward toward the raised hand (visible in the reflection), gradually straightens and turns slightly as the arm descends.
The body position, feet, and right arm remain essentially static; the mirror reflection tracks the arm and head changes exactly.
No camera movement is evident; background fixtures (frames, lights, barres) hold constant positions.
outside_clip_unknowns: The pose preceding frame 1 and the final destination of the arm/head motion are not shown; this is a mid-segment of an ongoing arm (port de bras) movement.
Whether the arm continues to lower or rises again after the clip is unseen.
uncertain_details: Exact ballet terminology or intent of the gesture is inferred only from visible motion.
Minor frame-to-frame shifts in the raised-hand angle are subtle and could partly reflect pose settling rather than deliberate motion.
